headline: Record revenue and wider margins drive a sharp profit jump
summary_short: CSX reported record quarterly revenue of $3,935M, up 10.1% y/y and 13.0% q/q, with operating income of $1,506M (+17.4% y/y) lifting net income to $1,002M (+20.9% y/y) and diluted EPS to $0.54 (+22.7% y/y).
summary_long: Revenue growth was driven by higher fuel surcharge revenue plus increased volume and pricing across merchandise, intermodal, and coal; total volume rose 6% y/y, led by 9% intermodal growth. Operating margin expanded 240bps to 38.3%, with operating income growing faster than revenue, consistent with cost growth trailing the top line. EBITDA rose to $1,942M (+12.1% y/y). Cash and short-term investments both rose sharply (cash +160.2% y/y, short-term investments +164.1% q/q), and shareholders' equity grew to $14,088M (+13.8% y/y). Weighted diluted shares were roughly flat at 1,859M. The release gives no forward guidance for the next quarter.
